dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: If you're here with a message from Lady Nefer, save the pleasantries and just say it. I can't stand watching you Seahook Gang types put on that little act of yours.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: How dare you...! Say that name once more, and I'll tear your mouth apart and break your limbs! Then I'll tie a couple of rocks to your feet and throw you into the sea to feed the fish!

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: Yes, now that sounds more like you people. Certainly sounds more like you, and Zinaida too.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Seethes) Boss Nef told me I couldn't touch you if you behaved... otherwise I would've already done it... I would've!

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: Alright, alright. Let's just get down to business, young lady. What does Lady Nefer want me to do?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hmph. You old geezer... Boss Nef sent me with a message. She says to tell you that she's found that clue you've been chasing, and in return, she wants your help dealing with the Wild Hunt on the east side of Paha Isle.

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: I understand. Thank Lady Nefer for me, and please let her know that I'm accepting this commission.
